[SWS_DM_02172] Operation
execution with wrong proximity_challenge
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD method to execute an operation is received and the
DiagnosticSov-
dOperation.proximityProofRequired
is set to
TRUE
for this
operation
and
the validation of the
proximity_response
according to [SWS_DM_01395] fails with
kProximityChallengeValidationFailed
, the DM shall deny the request and re-
turn an SOVD error 400 (Bad Request).
⌋
